goal: Agents cannot push, open a pull request, or trigger production CI until role policy and human approval allow it
scenarios: planner cannot push even with an approval record
generator push or pull request without approval is blocked and audited
generator push proceeds only after a different human grants approval
evaluator may run local checks without approval and cannot trigger production CI without approval
developer sees role capability boundaries before starting a task
constraints: high-risk Git and production actions require human approval
blocked actions and approval results are auditable
requester cannot approve their own request
nonGoals: hosted GitHub branch and pull-request write adapters
